Deliberate single-overshoot pop (not a multi-cycle bounce) chosen specifically to fix a real jitter bug: elastic.out's repeated oscillation, compressed 50x by the reduce-motion timeScale hack, was what read as jittering. back.out overshoots once and settles, matching the site's existing bounce/spring character elsewhere (CardStack, CertificationStack transitions) without that repeat.
